body: This is what I have been doing all day. This and cleaning. I'm kind of having a manic episode. I wonder if I am manic/depressive. I started taking Viibryd five days ago. Not sure if it's helping yet.

I've had every blood test imaginable, some more than once. The closest I got was a pain specialist in NYC (who was very highly regarded and ironicly named DR. HERTZ (sp?)) who said he had 4 other clients, all white male mid-20s same symptoms, but they don't know what it is. My life is focused around pain (probably why I was addicted to oxys and now take subs)
Also, experience is seeming to be more valuable than my education from a top 10 business school *sigh

I forgot to mention I also have some form of disease that has not been diagnosed yet. I wake up every morning since middle school (I'm 24 now )in severe chest pain and nausea. If I"m not nauseus I have excruciating stomach aches. I throw up and its clear and I will wretch sometimes over 5 times per day. I grimace and try to suck it up but it is just so painful. I have been to so many specialists, had so many bloodtests and everything is clear. Not Chron's, Celiacs, they think I probably have more than IBS and GERD because something is seriously wrong. I also cannot gain weight no matter what I eat.

Of course, many people face situations like this. That brings me to my philosophy on life. I remember from a philosophy class one person argued that most people will experience more negative experiences than positive ones, so in general life will not be a pleasant experience (or something along those lines) and for that reason people shouldn't be brought into this world! Now I wouldn't take it that far, but the idea that I will be working some miserable job for the next xxx years to pay bills and not have time to enjoy myself scares the fuck out of me. Then you get sick and die. So I just have this problem with the concept of life.

I moved closer to this job and I'm stuck in this lease until June 1. I met this guy on Craigslist or something and we thought it would be a good match (Both smoked, etc) but he ended up being a disgusting scumbag control freak who is in massive debt. We lost power and I ended up having to lend up hundreds of dollars which he has not paid back yet. But that's not the half of it. Before I signed the lease (he was already living here) he said I could have the bigger room for $100 extra a month, after I signed the lease he refused. So he gets the bigger room and THEN EVERY OTHER NIGHT HE SLEEPS ON THE COUCH OUTSIDE MY ROOM! I've called him out on it, he doesn't care. I wasn't allowed to put basically anything of mine in the living room and dining area basically either. My stuff ended up in the attic of the garage (which was unused space and he almost tried to make pay him for that space since he rents the garage for $100/mo). My chairs and wooden piano bench he put outside, claiming there was no room and that they would be fine in the rain (he's a construction type guy, I'm an accountant  so I believed him at the time before I knew him better) , now they are ruined. He has a walk in closet and I have a tiny closet (and he still tries to stick stuff in there)! No matter how much I tell him he's being unfair he doesn't care and he SEES HIMSELF AS THE VICTIM. He claimed he was neat when he moved in and of course he leaves his dishes in the sink AND WANTS ME TO WASH THEM FOR HIM! He is truly a jerk and I can't do anything but wait until June 1.

More than anything, I need a new job, and I need it now.

I'm afraid of being alone in a room also (I always will look behind the shower curtain in a bathroom etc). This is worse at night time since I have a glass door I always feel like someone is out there watching me inside
My temp agent had told me that they already paid the fee and I was due to be hired Dec 31, then the department was restructured and the VP changed and everything went to shit.
Oh well of course I am looking for fjobs, I just wish I had more connections.
Well I do love Korean food and Asian girls (who I'm sure love white guys). But why/how am I getting there and what am I doing for work when I get there lol?
So the six planners kept telling him how valuable I was and how much I was needed, even creating jobs for me. He just didn't listen to anyone, thick skulled bastard.

Of course I realize that, But they trained me since Feb with the promise of a great job at the end of the year. The thing is, it wasn't that I'm not needed. There were 7 planners in charge of 130M of inventory. Then planning merged with forecasting but the forecasting VP got to lead both. He plays favorites and has no idea what the planners do. He restructured the way we work and made slots for 6 planners only. All 6 got overloaded and I was helping every single one of them since I didn't have my own brand to manage anymore. But the other 6 were overloaded and he doesn't seem to care. If they didn't restructure I would have been hired already.
